Kittler on the Roof has played in three straight championship games (runner-up 2022 and 2023, champion 2024). Burrow, Taylor, and Nacua all need injury rebounds for a fourth trip.

essay:
The Jailyard spent its offseason arguing about tanking. Not one argument -- a hundred and twenty-one of them in a single month, plus punishment proposals, rule votes, and at least one poll nobody asked for.

{{media:preseason-2025-essay-opener}}

Here's what the shouting is really about: three seasons, three different champions. The Legion of Bouz in 2022, General Ken-obi in 2023, Kittler on the Roof in 2024. Nobody has repeated, nobody has separated, and every strategy -- win-now, tank-forever, hoard-picks -- still claims it's the smart one. 2025 is the referendum.

The favorites look familiar. Ken-obi rolls out four startable quarterbacks and a receiver room with no bad answers. MHJTIME counters with the best wideout trio in the league plus Travis Hunter -- and per Sacko, 'There's only 1 guy in the history of dynasty fantasy football idp that has ever been designated in sleeper as a DB and a WR.' We are, apparently, an IDP league. Kittler defends the crown with a starting lineup coming off more rehab appointments than anyone wants to count.

{{media:preseason-2025-receipts}}

And the receipts are already printing. Sacko, July 29: Skattebo is 'overated and about to be a bust.' Karim, four minutes later: 'Skatt about to go gang busters!' One of these men will be insufferable by Halloween. Meanwhile Chudders keeps bench-pressing next to the trophy case, two 2026 firsts and two 2027 firsts deep into a rebuild the chat has many opinions about.

Twelve teams, one trophy, and a group chat that forgets nothing. Somebody's take is going to age like milk in a hot car. This column is where we check the expiration dates.

rankings.blurb: The consensus No. 1, and it isn't close. Four startable quarterbacks, Saquon Barkley in his prime, and a CeeDee-Nico-London receiver room deep enough to survive a bye-week apocalypse. The knock? Somebody good has to sit every week. We're all just hoping you oversleep on waiver day.

Bijan Robinson and Breece Hall are the scariest backfield in the Jailyard, full stop. Caleb Williams enters year two with something to prove, and A.J. Brown does the rest. But your tight end room is Isaiah Likely and a prayer, and that's why the trophy talk stays quiet. For now.

Nobody's starting lineup scares people like yours: Chase, Nabers, Harrison Jr., plus Travis Hunter, the two-way rookie Sacko spent July hyping to anyone who'd listen. Trey McBride is a top-five tight end. Your backfield is Chuba Hubbard and vibes. One real running back and this is your year.

The blueprint finally worked: picks became C.J. Stroud, Brock Bowers, and a Hampton-Henderson backfield of pure upside. Your receiver room still makes you squint -- Worthy is a highlight reel, not an alpha. Pundits in the chat keep saying picks don't score points. 2025 is where you prove them wrong.

Josh Allen is the best quarterback in this league, and your running back committee oozes juice -- Achane, Irving, Judkins. Then the receivers show up and the party dies. With Rashee Rice's suspension looming, you're one alpha short of dangerous. Weekly thrill ride, as always.

Three straight trips to the final -- two silver medals, then the 2024 crown. So why sixth? Burrow, Taylor, and Nacua all spent chunks of last season in the trainer's room, and one more injury means actual Bryce Young snaps. Your floor is championship-grade. Your ceiling might be drywall.

Gibbs and Jeanty might be the best young backfield in the league, and you own more first-round picks than some teams own starters. The receiver room is Emeka Egbuka and echoes. The chat jokes about you icing every trade offer -- keep lifting, the trophy case is right there.

There's a rookie on this roster literally named Burden, and the branding writes itself. Jefferson and Aiyuk keep the lights on, but Kyler-or-Tua is a weekly coin flip and your backfield is a triage unit. The chat rumor mill says a Jefferson mega-deal could reset everything. Fraud tier until you pick a direction.

The 2022 banner still hangs, and Mahomes-to-ARSB still scares people. But McCaffrey and Mixon are staring down the cliff, and Hunter Henry is the tight end room. You stashed Cam Ward for the future -- the future keeps getting closer. Voltron needs new parts.

Sacko put it on the record in July: 'Burger great pick with tet. Honestly hes a baller.' McMillan joins Thomas Jr. and McConkey in a wagyu-grade receiver room -- while your backfield stays ramen. A 2024 semifinal run says spoiler. The QB platoon says spoiler is the ceiling.

You were one game from the title last December, and the core that got you there is another year older. Hurts remains a cheat code; Henry and Jacobs carry 1,500-carry odometers; Kupp, Allen, and Evans aren't aging backwards. One more run, or the Island of Misfit WR1s claims you.

Dead last in the preseason model with the third-best starting lineup in the league -- explain that one to the chat. Lamar, Tyreek, and Kelce are still video-game characters, but the age cliff is on the minimap and the pick cupboard is bare. You led the offseason in messages; lead it in wins or start the teardown.
